notes.title: Important update
notes.content: The game has more exciting levels, sardines will be attacked by a variety of animals, you need to operate sardines to avoid the attack of these Marine animals, and find the opportunity to beat them, players who have finished the game can click to continue the game, new levels will be displayed in front of you, you can continue until you pass the last level, the game also adds background music, Makes it feel better for you to play.
